title: Spring resistance
text: A guided sliding grip moves against a pair of springs for repeated finger curls and light, timed exercise.

title: Made for either hand
text: A shaped palm support and rounded thumb recesses on both sides provide a place to press against.

title: Flexible mounting
text: Integrated slots accept two 25 mm straps, so the device can be secured to a thigh or a round support.

title: Guided sessions
text: The companion iPhone app supports alternating sets, rest timers, timed endurance sessions and a local training log.
